nonblocking_findings: P2U2-1 [Nit] ux-browser-review: carryover of P2U1-2. The nav of .tmp/model-guide-preview/index.html holds no aria-current; the Overview link holds the class active only, while the track page real-work.html holds aria-current=page on its Real work link. Rationale: docs/index.html is pre-existing site markup and sits outside the Phase 2 diff, so the fix of 70ebfc5 caused no regression; the page that now holds the overview table keeps no aria-current for a screen reader. Fix: add aria-current=page to the Overview link in docs/index.html.

P2U2-2 [Nit] ux-browser-review: carryover of P2U1-3. The leaderboard and history scroll boxes of .tmp/model-guide-preview/index.html hold no tabindex, no role, and no aria-label, so they cannot take keyboard focus and have no accessible name. The new Model guide table box holds tabindex 0, role region, and aria-label Model guide table. Rationale: the two older boxes come from docs/index.html and sit outside the Phase 2 diff; the AX tree of index.html holds 2 region nodes, the section For this kind of work, use this model and the Model guide table only. Fix: give the two boxes tabindex 0, role region, and an aria-label.

P2U2-3 [Nit] ux-browser-review: carryover of P2U1-4. The model guide table of .tmp/model-guide-preview/index.html shows the base line on 2 of the 6 rows, app code base line 95.0 and test writing base line 98.7; the picked rows docs and ops and print-book audit show no base line. Rationale: guide.ts lines 49-53 tie the base line to the build total on the app code row and the tests total on the test writing row, and spec D18 ties the base line to the build and tests scores, so the other rows carry none by design. Fix: confirm the row scope with the PM, or show the base line of the picked model in every picked row.

P2U2-4 [Nit] ux-browser-review: carryover of U2 and of P2U1-5. The checker roles table of real-work.html needs 1111 px and its wrapper gives 1071 px at 1280 px, so the last column Mark sits outside the wrapper and needs a horizontal scroll. Rationale: known Phase 1 item, stays nonblocking; the box has a Tab stop and the ArrowRight key scrolls it, so the mark stays reachable. Fix: shorten the columns, or move the mark into the row, or raise the max width.
